_: Extra rooms to pin a check in, on top of the one the game puts it in.
generated/check_rooms.json says where each chest, barrier and box object
really is. That is the pin. This file is the hand-placed exception: a check
listed here keeps that pin AND gains one in each room named, because the
room the game uses is somewhere a player would not think to look, or is not
Keyed by AP location id in decimal, the same as check_rooms.json. Values
are map ids; tools/rooms.json says which of them the pack draws.
A check whose sections already land in several rooms needs no entry -- it
gets a pin in each of them on its own.

1851491.why: Selphia Plains D6 Chest - Shirt. The game puts it in MAP_ROOM_15, the inside of the house, which the pack draws no map for; pin it on the plains square the house stands on.

1851515.why: Obsidian Mansion B8 Chest - Cure Lv.1. The game puts it in MAP_CITY_04, Selphia town, since the mansion's B8 opens onto it; keep a pin in the mansion where the check is named.
